mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trainers) AS total_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trainers WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trainer_assignments WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS assigned_member_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members m WHERE m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.trainer_requested = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trainer_assignments ta WHERE ta.member_id = m.id AND ta.status = 'ACTIVE')) AS waiting_member_count

SELECT t.id AS trainer_id, t.name, t.phone, t.specialty, COUNT(ta.id) AS assigned_member_count, t.status, MAX(ta.started_at) AS latest_assigned_at FROM trainers t LEFT JOIN trainer_assignments ta ON ta.trainer_id = t.id AND ta.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND (t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND t.status = #{status}
GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.phone, t.specialty, t.status
HAVING t.status = 'ACTIVE't.status != 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.name, t.id

SELECT m.id AS member_id, m.name AS member_name, m.phone, m.joined_at FROM members m WHERE m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.trainer_requested = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trainer_assignments ta WHERE ta.member_id = m.id AND ta.status = 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY m.joined_at, m.id LIMIT 5

SELECT m.id AS member_id, m.name AS member_name, t.id AS trainer_id, t.name AS trainer_name FROM trainer_assignments ta JOIN members m ON m.id = ta.member_id JOIN trainers t ON t.id = ta.trainer_id WHERE ta.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY t.name, m.name
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM trainers WHERE id = #{trainerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM trainer_assignments WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trainer_assignments(member_id, trainer_id, status, started_at, assigned_by) VALUES(#{memberId}, #{trainerId}, 'ACTIVE', #{startedAt}, #{assignedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE trainer_assignments SET status = 'ENDED', ended_at = #{endedAt} WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
